title: Nabi ki Nawasi rida maangti hai
body:
Haye sadaat, haye sadaat..(2)
Risalat ka logo sila maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye ismat ki malka, ye bint e ali hai
jo pattharo ki barish mein kabse khadi hai
faqad do qadam raasta maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zibha hogaye iske be misl bhai
rasan mein kaha'n se kaha'n tak hai aayi
ye tumse ba-naame khuda maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Karo nau charagho se roshan ye raahein
khudara jhuka lo ye apni nigaahein
bhala kya ye iske siwa maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Nabi zaadiyo ko satate ho kyu tum
inhe naam lekar bulate ho kyu tum
ye marne ki apne dua maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. The farhan o qurbaan bibi ke jumle
mujhe mera bhai khule sar na dekha
ye kehke laee'n se rida maangti hai
<<MINI>>
nabi ki nawasi rida mangti hai
